_comment: SEO Utils desktop app MCP (local stdio). The launcher runs '<SEO Utils executable> mcp-stdio' after checking the build supports it; no token or Node.js. Requires SEO Utils newer than 2.5.0, MCP access, and Settings > MCP Server > Enable MCP Server.
_env: Off macOS, or for a non-default install, set SEO_UTILS_BIN to the executable shown in SEO Utils > Connect an AI app > Other MCP apps. No secrets in this file.

opencode._comment: The aidevops OpenCode plugin registers this automatically; use @seo-utils to connect. Replace /Users/YOU with your home directory.

mcp_servers_json._comment: Claude Desktop, Cursor, Antigravity and other mcpServers-style clients.
